5.48.1–3: Jovius meets Alaric at Ariminum and sends demands including annual gold, grain and settlement to the emperor

summary.de: Die Kaiserresidenz an der Adria war für die Antwort auf Alarichs Forderungen entscheidend. Sie lag weit vom belagerten Rom entfernt.
summary.en: The imperial residence on the Adriatic was where a response to Alaric’s demands could be made. The court was far from besieged Rome.
